title: A look at Nvidia's 10-person board, many of whom have known Jensen Huang for decades, including attorney Stephen Neal, VC Tench Coxe, and academic John Dabiri (Bloomberg)
summary: Bloomberg: A look at Nvidia's 10-person board, many of whom have known Jensen Huang for decades, including attorney Stephen Neal, VC Tench Coxe, and academic John Dabiri — Nvidia Corp.'s board of directors is meeting to discuss the fate of Chief Executive Officer Jensen Huang following reports …
